'''Ieerat''' was a [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] [[Chemist/Legends|chemist]]. Ieerat carried out a study of the atmosphere of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]] and the results suggested that a catastrophe that had occurred in the planet's past probably happened after the time of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]]. This supported the theory that the disaster was caused by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu/Legends|Boonta]], who had suposedly carried out extermination experiments on the world.
